'''Test environment WL428T73''' was a designation given by [[Iokath]] creators to a planet located in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] of the galaxy. Z17AX558 was chosen by [[Unidentified Iokath species|the species]] as a test environment for their weapons of mass destruction and a new fully-integrated, and optimized planetary assault platform completely eradicated the local sentient population. The invaders discovered an underground vault filled with artifacts, but were unable to determine their exact value.<ref>{{TORcite|type=codex|History of Iokath: Entry 3}}</ref>
